newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary c.bank to cut reserve int rates on June 16.
newsitem.headline: Hungary c.bank to cut reserve int rates on June 16.

text.p: The National Bank of Hungary said on Wednesday that it would cut on June 16 the interest rates it paid to Hungarian commercial banks on their obligatory reserves placed with the central bank.
The interest rate on forint reserves will be cut to 13.5 percent from 14.0 percent, while the interest rate on foreign currency reserves will be cut to 15 percent from 16 percent.
The central bank (NBH) said the measure was possible as the commercial banks' costs in generating their resources had decreased.
The NBH added that the reduction in foreign currency interest rates would be larger as the central bank planned to close the gap between its foreign currency and forint reserve interest rates.
